title: MOTION (BLUMENFIELD - HERNANDEZ) relative to funding for sidewalk repairs and other street improvements associated with the Reimagine Ventura Boulevard…
text:
[Council File 16-0149-S3; CD 3]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (BLUMENFIELD - HERNANDEZ) relative to funding for sidewalk repairs and other street improvements associated with the Reimagine Ventura Boulevard Streetscape Project in Council District 3.
Recommendations for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. TRANSFER and APPROPRIATE $2,546,560 in the Village at Westfield Topanga Public Benefits Trust Fund No. 56Q to a new Account in the Capital and Technology Improvement Expenditure Program Fund No.
100/54, Account No. TBD entitled "Reimagine Ventura Project" for sidewalk repairs and other street improvements associated with the Reimagine Ventura Boulevard Streetscape Project.
2. TRANSFER and APPROPRIATE $1,000,000 in the Council District 3 Real Property Trust Fund No. 685 AND $50,000 in the Council District 3 portion of the Council Discretionary Street Furniture Fund No. 43D/50 [TOTAL: $1,050,000] to the Accounts and in the amounts specified in the Street Services Fund No. 100/86 for sidewalk repairs and other street improvements associated with the Reimagine Ventura Boulevard Streetscape Project, as noted in the Motion, attached to the Council file.
3. AUTHORIZE the City Administrative Officer and/or Bureau of Street Services to make any corrections, clarifications or revisions to the above fund transfer instructions, including any new instructions; in order to effectuate the intent of this Motion, and including any corrections and changes to fund or account numbers to ensure the timely completion of the Reimagine Ventura Project; said corrections / clarifications / changes may be made orally, electronically or by any other means.
